value.rationale: Fingerprinter identified this as a Definitions/Glossary sheet.

The sheet has "PRODUCT FRAMEWORK ID" refIds like "CORE.PRD.001", "CORE.LOB.001", "CORE.COV.001" with PRODUCT/LINE OF BUSINESS/COVERAGE/SUB-COVERAGE hierarchy columns (e.g., "Bodily Injury Liability Coverage"), the hallmark of the product component model.
Columns include "FORM NUMBER" (e.g. "AC 001 AZ"), "FORM EDITION DATE", "FORM CATEGORY", and "DYNAMIC DATA", with rows like "State Endorsement – Arizona" — this is a form specification/schedule sheet.

The sheet is named "Core Forms Dynamic Data" with FORM NUMBER ("AC 107"), FORM NAME ("Waiver of Subrogation Endorsement"), and DYNAMIC FIELD NAME columns — a Dynamic Data endorsement schedule that maps to the forms domain.
The sheet has "RULE ID" (e.g. "CORE.RU001"), "RULE CATEGORY", "RULE CONDITION" and "RULE OUTCOME" columns, which are the defining condition->outcome structure of a governance rules sheet.

Despite the sheet name "Rule References", the stacked tables contain factor-table content like "TABLE NAME: Minimum Premiums" with "Amount ($)" values keyed by vehicle class (e.g. "Truck/Jeep/SUV", "Camper Trailer") and state lists, which is an actuarial rate/factor table rather than conditional rule logic.
Sheet has "RATING STEP ID" (e.g. "CORE.RAT.0001.01"), "ALGORITHM STEP" ("Base rate"), "CALCULATION", and "RATE REFERENCE" columns — the Core-format rating ROC signature.
